name: io.github.mau240987/garmin-mcp-server
description: Garmin Connect MCP server and race coach: official Personal API reads, deterministic training plans, FIT/ICS export, optional workout sync.

environment_variables.name: GARMIN_PERSONAL_API_KEY
environment_variables.description: Official Garmin Connect Personal API key (reads)

environment_variables.name: GARMIN_PERSONAL_API_KEY_EXPIRES
environment_variables.description: Expiry date of the Personal API key (YYYY-MM-DD), for advance warnings

environment_variables.name: GARMIN_EMAIL
environment_variables.description: Garmin Connect email, only for the unofficial login (first run; tokens are cached)

environment_variables.name: GARMIN_PASSWORD
environment_variables.description: Garmin Connect password, only for the unofficial login (first run)

environment_variables.name: GARMIN_ALLOW_UNOFFICIAL_WRITES
environment_variables.description: Enable workout create/schedule/delete via the unofficial backend (default false)

environment_variables.name: GARMIN_COACH_DATA_DIR
environment_variables.description: Where goals, plans and exports are stored (default ~/.garmin-coach-mcp/data)
